tables.comment: Squark-antisquark production cross sections with gluinos (and stops) decoupled. The cross-section values reported here assume a 10-fold squark degeneracy (i. e. ~u, ~d, ~c, ~s, ~b mass degenerate). They have been computed for decoupled gluinos, i. e. in the limit of large gluino masses (and therefore differ from the values in Fig. 1 of arXiv:1607.07741).
tables.note: The table is quoted as NNLO+NNLL; with a decoupled gluino only squark-antisquark production contributes.

The cross-section values reported here assume an 8-fold squark degeneracy (i. e. ~u, ~d, ~c, ~s mass degenerate). They have been computed for equal gluino and squark masses. tables.comment: Higgsino-like Cross Sections (fully-degenerate triplet). The production cross sections are computed at NLO plus next-to-leading-log (NLL) precision in a limit of mass-degenerate higgsino N2, C1 and N1 with all the other sparticles assumed to be heavy and decoupled. Assumes pure higgsino-like pair production and gives the sum of the relevant processes: N1N2, N1C1, N2C1 (=N1C1), C1C1 (N1N1 and N2N2 vanish).
tables.note: Sum of N1N2, N1C1, N2C1 and C1C1 for a mass-degenerate pure higgsino triplet.

convention.pdf: envelope of CTEQ6.6 and MSTW2008nlo90cl (PDF4LHC recommendation)

citation.working_group: LHC SUSY Cross Section Working Group

tables.comment: The following cross sections are for pure higgsino-like pair production. They differ from the fully-degenerate case because here not all of the higgsinos are assumed to have the same mass, but there is a mass splitting between the two lightest neutralinos of dM = m(N2) - m(N1), and the mass of the lighter chargino is half-way in between the two neutralinos. These NLO+NLL cross-sections were computed using Resummino and an envelope of the CTEQ6.6 and MSTW2008nlo90cl PDFs. In addition, a dedicated calculation of the branching ratios (BR) of the into two leptons and the into a lepton and neutrino (including the tau lepton(s) where possible) was done with SUSYHit. In this calculation the decays of N2 into C1+X or N1+photon are not allowed. The values are listed in the TWiki.
tables.note: Chargino mass half-way between N1 and N2.

convention.pdf: envelope of CTEQ6.6 and MSTW2008nlo90cl (PDF4LHC recommendation)

aliases.rule: In a pure-wino spectrum the neutral wino partner of C1 is labelled N1 when the wino is the lightest state and N2 when a bino is lighter; the tabulated pure-wino C1-N2 cross section applies to C1-N1 with m = m(C1).
With a lighter bino, the two neutral higgsinos are labelled N2 and N3; the tabulated pure-higgsino neutral pair applies with m = common higgsino mass.
For a mass-degenerate pure higgsino triplet the source states sigma(N2 C1) = sigma(N1 C1) (LHC SUSY WG higgsino twiki).
